profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer at Sap
profile.summary: Software Engineer with more than 10 years of industry experience with developing tools and infrastructures as well as building test harnesses and infrastructure automation. Strong in problem solving skills and adding new features in existing software. Interested in a software program that checks robustness, performance and availability, as well as developing a software launching in platforms from on-prem and public clouds.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: - Normalize logging system from K8s Apps from Pyhton, Go, and TypeScript to AWS CLS (cloud logging system)

positions.title: SDE II
positions.description:
-Initiated kubevirt to be adopted in CaaS Platform
-Tested SUSE helm manifests for Helm3
-Developed an internal tool, microCaaSP https://github.com/suseclee/microCaaSP
-Refactoring a test framework based on declarative yaml files

positions.title: Quality Engineer III
positions.description:
Quality Engineer III (Photon OS)       						     July 2017 ~ March 2018
Quality Engineer II (Photon OS)       						     July 2015 ~ July 2017 
-Developed test harness infrastructure for Photon OS CI using Pyvmomi from VMware                                                                                
-Initiated Photon Controller deployment automation using nested ESXies
-Developed testing automation on launched Micro Photon OS VM using vncdotool
-Initiated all unit tests (make check) for Photon OS packages in SPEC files 
-Developed QE dashboard for Photon OS using Tableau
-Helped Photon OS (replaced from Sles12) to be shipped in vCenter Server Appliance
-Tested Photon OS 1.0 GA release from Photon OS TP2

positions.title: SDET
positions.description:
SharePoint SNAP team
- Implemented auto-heal for SPO Usage Databases (SCOM MP and Joblets). Alerts were reduced from 20-30/month to 1-2/month. 
- Initiated new logic for C/D drive cleanup from low disk space for +20K servers (SCOM MP and PowerShell). Alerts were reduced from 70-120 to 10 and fast code submission to deployment in production 
- Maintained configuration for SharePoint testing servers for performance
- Analyzed performance issues using usage database, FFT database and COSMOS

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Trailblazers team
Working with Intranet financial tools
building up test automation for financial software using ruby.
added manual testing skills for the system

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Working with Client form Polymer Ohio.
I am working with Polymer Portal which is composed of Drupal, Moodle, and VM. The purpose is to help polymer people to accelerate their development and training through OSC Virtual Machine through polymer portal's interface.

positions.title: Kulai Rice Developer
positions.description:
Setup and Configuration of Kuali
Unit Testing for QA with Junit testing and eCobertura
Training Documentation for new developers

positions.title: .NET developer
positions.description:
Building up POS System for small business using Microsoft .NET
Design GUI interface with C#
Design inventory Database (MS SQL)
Interaction with font End and back end through ADO.NET
